passages.p2: Read the text and choose the best answers. (Ips) FRANCE France is a state in Western, Europe with several overseas territories and islands (31) ...........on other continents and in the Indian, Pacific, and Atlantic oceans. It is bordered by Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Monaco; with Spain and Andorra to the South. France is linked to the United Kingdom by the Channel Tunnel. France is the largest West-Europe country (32) ............ 11.035.000 km2, just behind the one of the United States square km (11.351.000). France is a founding member state of the European Union and is the largest one by area. France (33) .......... a major power for several centuries with strong cultural, economic, military and political influence in Europe and in the world. With an estimated population of 65.4 million people (as if 1 Jan. 2010), France is the 20th most populous country in the world. With 81.9 foreign tourists, in 2007, France (34) ............ as the first tourist destination in the world, ahead of Spain (58.5 million 2006) and the United States (51.1 million in 2006). These 81.9 million figures exclude people staying less than 24 hours in France, such as Northern Europeans crossing France on their way to Spain or Italy during the summer. France features cities of high cultural interests and seaside resorts, ski resorts, and rural regions that many enjoy for their (35)...........and green tourism.
passages.p3:
Read the passage and answer the questions. (1pt)
Clothes can tell a lot about a person. Some people like very colorful clothes because they want everyone to look at them and they want to be the center of the universe. Other people like to wear nice clothes, but their clothes aren't colorful or fancy. They don't like people to look at them. Clothes today are very different from the clothes of the 1800s. One difference is the way they look. For example, in the 1800s all women wore dresses. The dresses all had long skirts. But today women don't always wear dresses with long skirts. Sometimes they wear short skirts. Sometimes they wear pants. Another difference between 1800s and today is the cloth. In 1800s, clothes were made only from natural kinds of cloth. Why do some people like very colorful clothes ?
options: A. Because they like different colors.
B. Because they want to be the center of the universe.
C. Because they don't want everyone to look at them.
D. Because colorful clothes are always nice.

questions.content: What kind of clothes do other people like to wear?
options: A. They like to wear modern clothes.
B. They like to wear colorful clothes.
C. They like to wear beautiful clothes.
D. They like to wear traditional clothes.

questions.content: Were the clothes of the 1800s the same as clothes today?
options: A. Yes, the clothes of the 1800s were the same as clothes today.
B. No, clothes today are very different from the clothes of the 1800s.
C. No, the clothes of the 1800s were the same as clothes today.
D. Yes, clothes today are not different from the clothes of the 1800s.

questions.content: And what kind of clothes did all women wear in the 1800s ?
options: A. In the 1800s, all women wore dark skirts.
B. In the 1800s, all women wore long-sleeved blouses.
C. In the 1800s, all women wore modern clothing.
D. In the 1800s, all women wore dresses.

questions.content: What do sometimes women wear today?
options: A. They wear short skirts and pants.
B. They wear short - sleeved skirts and suits.
C. They wear T-shirts and pants.
D. They wear long skirts and jeans.
